brief:
Foreign ministers from Egypt, Qatar, Jordan, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, Turkey, and Indonesia denounced what they characterized as illegal measures aimed at entrenching occupation control and annexing Palestinian land, according to Shehab Wire. The statement referenced accelerating settlement expansion as part of their condemnation.

The joint rebuke reflects coordinated diplomatic opposition from major Arab states alongside Turkey and Indonesia to Israeli settlement policy in Palestinian territories.
